facility.name: Oak Leaf Kids Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Skill Classes,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3602 CHAHA RD, ROWLETT, TX, 75088

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A nail was observed to be sticking from the top of the slide structure on the toddler playground.     The slide on the toddler playground was observed to have cracks that could cause pinching or pose the risk of clothing getting caught.    The Prek playground has borders around the playground that is uneven.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The playground did not have loose-field at the proper depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Maintenance to the outdoor play area is not being conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with an EPI pen did not have the parent's signature of the the allergy form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The gate from the playground to the parking lot was not in working order.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety restraint devices for child used when vehicle is on and during all time vehicle in motion: A child was not wearing their seatbelt after being picked up from school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety restraint devices for child used when vehicle is on and during all time vehicle in motion (26 TAC §746.5607(e))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: A school age child was left on the van for approximately ten minutes after school pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: The driver failed to check the children's names off of the roster when they returned to the center which resulted in a child being left on a vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: Two children walked out of the front door during pick up time.  A caregiver was in the front office when the incident occurred.  The children were brought in immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The fence had a gap where the gate connects.  The gap was large enough for a child to get through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation had a situation that placed a child in an unssafe situation and did not report it to Licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unattended in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The play structure at the operation had several broken wood pieces that presented safety hazards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The operation did not have the proper amount of loose fill required for structures at 5ft.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: One infant caregivers SIDS Training expired 07/27/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Sanitize Each Crib: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient.  Two infant cribs had soiled crib sheets that had not been changed at least six days after children were absent or no longer in care at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Sanitize Each Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(b))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: One vehicle did not have the child safety alarm installed. The vehicle is ued to transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation, and found to be deficient.  The operation's sign-in/out tracking system for school age children did not include the date, time of arrival, and time of departure; and the employee or parent's initials or other unique identifier.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Exceeding Maximum Group Size -Ratio Meet: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation, and found to be deficient.  The school age classroom was out of ratio before adding additional four and five year old children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size -Ratio Meet (26 TAC §746.1611(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation, and found to be deficient.  The Director did not ensure compliance of the Minimum Standards, while having prior knowledge of on-going child to caregiver ratio issues.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: One caregiver was caring for twelve children. The specified age group is 18 months to 24 months.     Two caregivers were caring for thirty-nine children. The Specified age group is three years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not share a copy of an incident report with parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument: A caregiver was observed using prohibited punishments with a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was recorded yelling at children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A caregiver did not completely clean a child's sippy cup, leaving cleaning liquid (hand soap) inside. The cup was given to a child and they drunk the cleaning liquid (hand soap) that was left in the cup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Two children were not properly strap in highchairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: Two caregivers was caring for 23 children. The specified age group was two years old.     One caregiver was caring for forty children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)
